dyk: Syria's only Olympic gold medal was won by a Ghada: heptathlete Ghada Shouaa, at Atlanta in 1996.
dyk_source: World Athletics, “Ghada Shouaa: The only Olympic gold medallist for Syria”, 15 Sep 2021

add.name: Ghada Shouaa
add.note: Heptathlete; world champion in 1995 and winner of Syria's first Olympic gold medal, at Atlanta 1996.
